title: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing spurious goods resulting in death
description: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing spurious goods resulting in the death of a consumer

content.offence: Manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any spurious goods resulting in the death of a consumer
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than seven years, but may extend to imprisonment for life and with fine which shall not be less than ten lakh rupees

aliases: spurious goods resulting in fatal injury
